study_identification_part.si_4_title: Detecting accelerated retinal decline in mental disorders through normative modeling

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: GAMLSS was used with fractional polynomials to model age effects. A normal distribution was selected after comparison with other distributions (Generalized Gamma, Box-Cox t).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: To model decline in macular thickness, its coronal subfields, as well as RNFL and GC-IPL, we used GAMLSS in R... To model the effects of age on retinal thickness, which are known to be non-linear... we used fractional polynomials... The normal distribution... was therefore chosen
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Georgiadis2024.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model generation and specification / Dependent variables & Distribution choice

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Total macular thickness (including coronal subfields), Retinal Nerve Fiber Layer (RNFL), and Ganglion Cell-Inner Plexiform Layer (GC-IPL).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Here, we focused on retinal measurements of total macular thickness... including the segregated macular subfields... as well as macular sublayers; the retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL...) and ganglion cell-inner plexiform layer (GC-IPL...)
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Georgiadis2024.pdf.md: Methods / Design, setting, and participants

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age (modeled with fractional polynomials), Sex (used for specific models), Laterality (used for specific models), Image quality, and Ethnic background. Note: Sex and Laterality were used to build specific models (stratification) in the main analysis, effectively accounting for them.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: To model the effects of age on retinal thickness... we used fractional polynomials... Image quality and reported ethnic background were also included as covariates... We built sex- and laterality-specific models for each metric
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Georgiadis2024.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model generation and specification / Predictor variables and covariates
